title: Acquirer: OneSteel Trading Pty Ltd; Target: Midalia Steel

body_sections.Summary: OneSteel Trading Pty Ltd acquired Midalia Steel, a West Australian steel products distributor.
body_sections.Market definition: The market for distribution of steel and other metal products in Western Australia
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered the acquisition of Midalia Steel by OneSteel is not likely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the Western Australian market for metals distribution because: Another distributor of similar size (Smorgon) and a range of smaller distributors are capable of competing actively with the merged entity; The level of imports overall and across most product segments suggests the market will remain both contestable and competitive.
